faq.q: How do I choose the best name for my Sam Sawet?
faq.a: Choosing the perfect name for your Sam Sawet 🐱 depends on their personality, appearance, and your personal taste! Observe your Sam Sawet's unique behaviors — are they playful or calm? Bold or shy? Pick a name that feels right when you say it aloud. Short, 1-2 syllable names often work best as they are easier for animals to recognize and respond to.
